## Definitions

### workloadInfo

The generated workload, so RPS is only compared between runs with the same hash.

| Field             | Type     | Required | Description                                 |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `hash`            | `string` | Yes      |                                             |
| `generator`       | `string` | Yes      | Name and version of the workload generator. |
| `chars_per_token` | `number` | No       | Calibrated from usage during warmup. &gt; 0 |

### httpVersion

Type: `"1.1"`, `"2"`

### engineInfo

| Field           | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`          | `string`  | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `version`       | `string`  | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `max_in_flight` | `integer` | No       | The engine's cap on requests in flight at once (loadgen). When a target falls behind, in-flight requests pile up to this cap and sends wait for a slot; the analysis tells that apart from a slow client (target\_saturated). ≥ 1 |

### hopTransports

How every hop used by this run was secured. A hop that was not used is omitted. Bundle format version 1 recorded a mode string per hop (mtls, tls or platform); readers upgrade it when they load such a bundle.

| Field          | Type                                                    | Required | Description |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target`       | [hopTransport](/reference/schemas/common/#hoptransport) | Yes      |             |
| `prometheus`   | [hopTransport](/reference/schemas/common/#hoptransport) | No       |             |
| `api`          | [hopTransport](/reference/schemas/common/#hoptransport) | No       |             |
| `object_store` | [hopTransport](/reference/schemas/common/#hoptransport) | No       |             |
